title: DBFlux redesign: Query error position (#1030) · dark
brief: Issue #1030 as reshaped by the maintainer: mark the error where the server reports it with an editor diagnostic, and let the user jump there on request with Go to error; nothing moves on its own.

artboards.title: Failed run marker, Go to error, menu and palette entries, no-position state
artboards.tradeoff: The jump lives on the toast and as a command without a default key, so it never competes with typing; users who dismiss the toast find it in the pane actions menu or palette.
